reason: This is the only offered action, and it follows the lane-born stars into the returning galaxy.
expectation: I expect the stars to pass through the galaxy while their paths change, though I am unsure where they will end up.

effect: The stars pass through the returning galaxy without colliding like their parent gas clouds, and their paths become part of a shared stellar body.
reaction: The contrast with the gas crossing made this brief ending satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the lane-born stars through the crossing was worthwhile because it connected their formation from gas to their different behavior as widely separated stars.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter was very short, with only one offered action, so there was little opportunity for a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: The result clarified that becoming stars changed how this matter behaved in a galactic crossing: the stars passed among one another rather than colliding like their parent clouds.

arbitrary.text: The action had a clear purpose, though it was the only available choice.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see how the shared galaxy develops, though this chapter alone offered little gameplay choice.
